name: The Ghost of Kutha
source:
KUTHA, LAND OF BABYLON
FIRST MILLENNIUM BC

It’s a day like the others for you. Get up, help in your family shop, become a ghost…
Yeah, become a ghost.
It’s a you thing.

No, you haven’t died. Not that you remember. It just happens. Like some have a limp or a hiccup, you switch back and forth between living and already lived. 

Not really practical, but you can’t exactly ask for help. Unless you want to be exorcised on the spot, which you really don’t find enticing.

Well, it’d be easier to survive if you didn’t live in Kutha, where people particularly worship the gods of the Irkalla, the underworld… and where pretty much everyone and their cousin is an ashipu. 

Your ghostly self has also gotten fairly known in the city, seeing that no one has ever managed to catch them long enough to exorcise them.

Well… for now.

See if you can survive! 

[Edited from [url=https://xenogio.itch.io/the-ghost-of-kutha]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
巴比伦之地，库塔城
公元前一千纪

对你而言，今天原本和往常的任何一天没什么两样：起床，在自家铺子里帮忙，然后变成幽灵……
没错，变成幽灵。
这就是你的独门体质。

不，你并没有死——至少在你记忆里还没死过。这种事就是会自然而然地发生。就像有人走路跛脚、有人爱打嗝一样，你会在“活人”与“亡魂”两种状态之间来回切换。

这体质实在算不上实用，偏偏你又没法向旁人求助——除非你想被人当场超度驱除，而这种下场显然一点也不吸引你。

唉，要是你不住在库塔城，活命大概还能容易些——毕竟这里的居民格外尊崇冥界“伊尔卡拉”的诸神……而且满城上下几乎人人都是驱魔祭司“阿希普”，连他们家的远房表亲也不例外。

你的幽灵形态在城里也已经颇有名气了，因为至今还没有任何人能抓住你足够长的时间来完成驱魔仪式。

嗯……至少目前还没有。

来看看你究竟能不能活下去吧！

[摘自[url=https://xenogio.itch.io/the-ghost-of-kutha]itch.io[/url]（经编辑）]
